title: A free Thopter made Frogmite cheaper
matchup: Mirrodin Affinity against opposing artifact aggro
story: I had Seat of the Synod and Vault of Whispers on the battlefield and no creature yet. During my main phase I cast Ornithopter for zero mana. It resolved as a 0/2 flyer and became my third artifact. Frogmite cost four generic mana normally, but affinity for artifacts reduced that by three. I tapped Seat of the Synod to pay the remaining one mana and cast Frogmite. Tapping the artifact land did not stop it from counting for affinity. My opponent still faced two new creatures, even though I had spent only one mana.
review: Two artifact lands + Ornithopter after resolution =3 artifacts. Frogmite {4} affinity reduces to {1}. Seat of Synod taps to pay blue amount generic, still artifact. Zero mana spell uses stack; user controls newly played creature cannot attack this turn.
claim: representative reconstruction; not a historical match or quotation
